name: Hotel Bel-Air
insider_take: This legendary pink palace has been Hollywood's best-kept secret since 1946, tucked away in a secluded 12-acre canyon where A-listers have escaped paparazzi for decades.
whats_special: Hotel Bel-Air sits on the only naturally spring-fed lake in Los Angeles, home to famous swans that have become the hotel's signature. The property features the original 1920s Mission Revival architecture and houses Wolfgang Puck's exclusive restaurant where Grace Kelly held her wedding reception planning meetings.
pro_tip: Book the Swan Lake Suite for direct lake views, or visit during golden hour when the canyon's natural lighting creates the perfect Instagram moment by the iconic stone bridge.
dont_miss: The hotel's legendary Bar & Lounge where Marilyn Monroe was discovered, and take a stroll through the surrounding Bel-Air neighborhood to spot some of LA's most exclusive mansions, including homes once owned by Elizabeth Taylor and Frank Sinatra.
pros: Iconic luxury property with legendary Hollywood glamour and celebrity history
Stunning 12-acre garden oasis with lush landscaping and tranquil swan lake
World-class spa and wellness facilities with comprehensive treatment menu
Michelin-starred dining at Wolfgang Puck at Hotel Bel-Air
cons: Secluded Bel Air location requires transportation to major attractions
